releasebot: Hotfix queued: kv-ttl-atomic -> canary. Window 03:10-03:20 UTC due to embed 503 surge. Paging @oncall SRE.

tara: oncall. requesting an expedited fastcut path if canary is clean for 2m. customer impact high. :exclamation:

evan: eng +1. change is tiny: ttl bump + atomic write guard. image pinned to sha: d4e5f6a7. no migrations.

sre_maya: i'll watch. abort if errors > 0.8% sustained 60s or p99 > 280ms. will keep EU on stable until green.

tara: ops checklist:
```
- deploybot deploy --env=canary --image=redwood/hotfix:d4e5f6a7
- healthcheck /healthz 3x
- monitors: embeddings-503, kv-errors, embed-p99
- rollback: deploybot rollback --to-sha=prev-11bb
```

opsbot: preflight OK: image verified, infra quotas OK, canary nodes ready, CI artifact scanned.

deploybot: Starting canary (2 pods) with sha d4e5f6a7. Opening ephemeral alert channel.

sre_maya: observing dashboards. lowered page thresholds for this thread.

opsbot: canary minute1: errors 0.5%, p99 125ms. minute2: errors 0.2%, p99 118ms. burn-in PASS.

tara: initiating fastcut to 25% and pin image. keep rollback hot.

evan: eng standing by to run rollback if SRE requests. previous sha noted.

opsbot: post-cut quick checks: 2m avg errors 0.23%, p99 140ms. monitoring 10m.

sre_maya: EU still siloed; will approve global widen after 5m EU green.

opsbot: +8m: errors 0.18%, p99 142ms, no alerts.

tara: drafting release note: "hotfix: atomic kv write + TTL tweak to prevent intermittent 503s under embed load; pinned d4e5f6a7." link: https://docs.internal/releases/1725205555-kv-hotfix

evan: release owner signoff.

sre_maya: no rollback needed. closing ephemeral channel in 5. :white_check_mark:
